reviewer: AI independent semantic reviewer /root/blind_train_review; not human sign-off
method: All records reviewed through an allowlist projection of posting metadata, target, context, and evidence hash; gold, rationale, tags, reviewState, reviewer, reviewedAt, employerGroup, and policyFamily were hidden. The six labels and reasons in this artifact were saved before opening train gold for comparison.
blindingLimit: The required INDEPENDENT-REVIEW-STARTED-2026-10-10.md was read first and disclosed selected prior labels/findings. These IDs are explicitly recorded; this is not claimed to be fully blind. No model training, calibration, or inference was run.
evidenceHashDefinition: sourceEvidenceSha256 is the frozen record's existing evidence hash. reviewEvidenceSha256 is SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify({postingId,employer,jobTitle,country,coverage,target,context}) in that key order, preserving extracted text exactly.
